members.name: Planner
members.role: Writes a plan for a new issue and revises it on feedback

members.name: Architect
members.role: Turns an approved plan into ordered sub-issues

members.name: Builder
members.role: Implements one sub-issue per PR, as a stack

members.name: Reviewer A
members.role: Reviews PRs for correctness and tests

members.name: Reviewer B
members.role: Reviews PRs for security, maintainability and operations
